scripts.dev: pnpm tailscale:serve; concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @intella/api dev" "pnpm --filter @intella/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @intella/shared build && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @intella/eval typecheck && pnpm --filter @intella/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @intella/web typecheck
scripts.prisma:migrate: node prisma/ensure-sqlite.mjs && pnpm pre-migrate && prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: node prisma/ensure-sqlite.mjs && pnpm pre-migrate && prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:push: echo 'db push is disabled — schema changes must go through Prisma Migrate with committed migrations (pnpm prisma:migrate). See docs/Intella_Migration_Discipline.md' && exit 1
scripts.setup: pnpm prisma:migrate:deploy && prisma db seed && pnpm setup:pair
